metadata.description: Diagnostic trees for syntax, layout DAG cycles, visual discrepancies, and CLI debugging toolkit

tree.name: syntax_and_parse_failures
tree.step: Check for var assignment (>var = val;) or colon after offset (offset 10px;).
Font fallback commas must be inside single string (">font = 'Inter, sans-serif';").

tree.name: layout_and_dag_failures
tree.step: Identify cycle in report and break mutual dependency with landmark absolute anchor.
Remove explicit 'at:' from stack children so 'gap:' controls spacing.
Target ID does not exist or has typo.

tree.name: visual_discrepancies
tree.step: Ensure color-interpolation="sRGB" and radial glow center alpha >= 0.25.
Register font via @font or add 15%-20% safety padding.
Verify filter bounds are expanded (x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%").
Canvas renders text from top baseline. Apply Cap-Height Offset (+1.5px to +2.5px at 1x, +3-5px at 2x) or run pixel-scan verification script.
Align glyph center to icon bounding center. Never assume identical y-coordinate results in visual center alignment.

command.description: Print AST and layout evaluation metrics
Draw bounding boxes (red), anchor vectors (blue), padding/margin (green)
Check syntax and validation without writing files
